lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5 to 6 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters; centroids are arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern with higher density in the mid-lateral region posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by sharp vertical luminance gradients; the dorsal ridge is the most prominent, followed by two lower-intensity ridges on the flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-luminance elongated features (remoras) attached to the pectoral fin trailing edge and the ventral-posterior body surface.
